verdict.rationale: Maritime is a platform for hosting AI agents, so built-in AI insights over a user's data is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no first-party feature that analyzes the user's data (agents, builds, logs, usage) and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Hosted template agents that can send scheduled digests are agent workloads the user deploys, not a product insights capability, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
